body.name: Mixed log-error coefficient
body.construction: For \(b_{\ell}=\rho c_{\ell3}\), \(B_{\rho,\ell}=\int_0^1\!\int_0^1 \frac{m'(q(b_{\ell}e^{s x_{\ell}})+q(b_{\ell}e^{t z_{\ell}})-q(b_{\ell}))}{m(q(b_{\ell}e^{s x_{\ell}}))m(q(b_{\ell}e^{t z_{\ell}}))}\,dt\,ds\) and \(C_{\rho,\ell}=B_{\rho,\ell}\psi(A_{\ell}B_{\rho,\ell})\).
